name: Enterprise Messaging Groups — Frontend & UX
honestAssessment: Phase 29.3 delivers a multi-step Group Create Wizard, tabbed group management (members, invites, join requests, modes, lockdown), multi-typer/recording labels, pin banner, and permission-aware composer restrictions inside existing Messages. Translation and Scrolitha continue on existing paths (no new AI backend). Full Playwright visual suite and production deploy remain deferred. No database modifications; no Cloud Run deploy.
rollbackPlan: Revert geezle FE commit; wizard unused; GroupManagePanel falls back to prior behavior if rolled back entirely.
risks: Enterprise APIs require Phase 29.1 migration when eventually deployed; UI degrades gracefully (22.2 paths)
People picker still accepts user IDs (enterprise directory search can enhance later)
Playwright E2E visual certification deferred to Phase 29.6
